pdva-p01-v01.quick_english: Enjoy peace always; with few words, stop the chatter-course; by its stopping-way — what, how is this, who am I — don't doubt. What shines unbroken in sequence, making being and non-being shine apart — that void, Śiva's abode, the highest real thing, brahman — then who grasps here?

pdva-p01-v02.quick_english: If you reach reality only by first rejecting non-reality, that is just non-reality. If non-reality is then reality itself — that is not reality, not such.

pdva-p01-v03.quick_english: Whatever shines, not apart from shining — if you say even difference shines, it does not shine in shining — so abandon the grasping of its breaking-ways. In dream, having become dream-ness, mere play, no fright-maker — sword-blows, water-plunges, fire-eating, thunder-claps and the rest.

pdva-p01-v04.quick_english: Resolving first on knowledge-action-measuring — whatever you declare, sir, what distinguishes it from the inert? Quivering, even the inert — is it not the nondual-awareness-abode, beginningless-eternal-ungraspable-true-formed?

pdva-p01-v05.quick_english: If you, the illuminator of beings, are smeared by them — what is that to you? If it shines, hail — your unbroken greatness even there. If not, it is not — thus even so, both ways, unrestrained-unfettered, with unbroken delusion ever content and great — ever-awake you are, sir.

pdva-p01-v06.quick_english: Send sight outward, past the target-path — Bhairava-mimicry would be mere fraud. For the sky of nondual waking there is no outside; no inside for the spaceless-unfolding-abode.

pdva-p01-v07.quick_english: When desire-spread-delusion rises — whatever flashes, watch just that. In beginning, middle, and ends, if there — shining, shining, all dissolves into you.

pdva-p02-v08.quick_english: Delusion — dense with suffering, conjecture, piling thought, with causes rising one after another, teeming with chains of error, like a mirage-city — if it does not shine in consciousness-sky, the ground of dual-nondual-thought, where else could the highest rest stand, even for the many-selfed?

pdva-p02-v09.quick_english: In dream, after all, the unreal itself is the road; in deep-sleep's abode there is manifestation — beyond that, in the conditionless consciousness-sky, what grasp is his? In waking, if the heap of things stood earth-firm even for a moment somewhere — then by knowing, past that, this as apart — what refutation even there?

pdva-p02-v10.quick_english: Whatever lights there are, in me, in the highest sky having found room — they shine in me, in eternal glory, undistinguished. I am He — unfeigned, eternal, of unbroken measure, infinite, true, free, dispelling the darkness of the foe-pair, nondual and not, with beginningless waking-light.

pdva-p02-v11.quick_english: Let time, reckoning the measures, reckon; let the creator eagerly create; brought under another's rule by command, let love churn. Play-pomp, sky-abiding as it were, in self-drawn-line-sequence — let it abide in body and all; in distorted-great-delusion's evil — what do I not see?

pdva-p02-v12.quick_english: Who here, sir, whom do I devour? Who here, sir, whom do I suddenly slay? Who here, sir, whom — the supreme-waking-abode-devouring-frenzied-bodied — do I drink?

pdva-p02-v13.quick_english: The shattering of becoming-born fear, the scaring of affliction-jackals; on wisdom's yoke, even of the wise, for once, what an awakening. From the upsurge of beyond-contentment in dense-forest wandering, Hari Rāmyadeva made the non-difference-elephant trumpet.

pdva-p01-v01.speaker: Poet (maṅgala)
pdva-p01-v01.question: What is enjoined first?
premises: Enjoy peace always; with few words stop the chatter-course.
By its stopping-way ask what-how-this-who-I; don't doubt.
pdva-p01-v01.inference: The maṅgala injunction: peace, brevity, cessation as the gate; self-questioning without doubt.

pdva-p01-v02.speaker: Poet (dialectician)
pdva-p01-v02.question: What follows from the condition?
premises: If reality reached only by first rejecting non-reality, that is non-reality.
If non-reality is then reality itself — not reality, not such.
pdva-p01-v02.inference: Conditional refutation: mediated attainment collapses into its means; identity-claims about tattva fail both ways.

pdva-p01-v03.speaker: Poet (dialectician)
pdva-p01-v03.question: What shines?
premises: Whatever shines, not apart from shining; even difference claimed to shine does not shine in shining.
Abandon the grasping of breaking-ways; dream become dream-ness, mere play, no fright-maker.
pdva-p01-v03.inference: Non-difference of appearance and awareness: difference is not a second shining; grasping modes of breaking is abandoned.

pdva-p01-v04.speaker: Poet (dialectician)
pdva-p01-v04.question: What distinguishes from the inert?
premises: Resolving first on knowledge-action-measuring; whatever declared — what distinction from the inert.
Quivering, even the inert — is it not the nondual-awareness-abode.
pdva-p01-v04.inference: The inert quivers too: if it moves, what excludes it from the advaya-awareness-abode — beginningless, eternal, ungraspable, true-formed?

pdva-p01-v05.speaker: Poet (dialectician)
pdva-p01-v05.question: What if the illuminator is smeared?
premises: Illuminator of beings, if smeared by them — what is that to you.
If it shines, hail: unbroken greatness even there; if not, it is not — both ways ever-awake.
pdva-p01-v05.inference: Smearing cannot touch the illuminator: shining or not, greatness stays unbroken; both alternatives dissolve into ever-awake being.

pdva-p01-v06.speaker: Poet (gaze-practice)
pdva-p01-v06.question: Where should sight go?
premises: Send sight outward past the target-path; Bhairava-mimicry would be mere fraud.
No outside for nondual-waking sky; no inside for spaceless-unfolding-abode.
pdva-p01-v06.inference: Gaze sent past every target: inner and outer denied alike; imitating the state without being it is fraud.

pdva-p01-v07.speaker: Poet (desire-practice)
pdva-p01-v07.question: What is watched?
premises: When desire-spread-delusion rises, whatever flashes — watch just that.
In beginning, middle, ends, if there — shining, shining, all dissolves into you.
pdva-p01-v07.inference: Desire-practice: attend the flash itself at every phase; the watcher shining, all melts into you.

pdva-p02-v08.speaker: Poet (cosmologist)
pdva-p02-v08.question: Where does delusion rest?
premises: Delusion dense with suffering, conjecture, piling thought, error-chains, mirage-city-like.
If it does not shine in consciousness-sky, ground of dual-nondual-thought — where else the highest rest.
pdva-p02-v08.inference: Delusion has no other seat: failing to appear in consciousness-sky, no highest rest stands anywhere — even for the many-selfed.

option_choices.reason: √cakās (shine) fits the cidvyomni light-context; the doublet kāstu takes the standing-sense for niṣṭhā.
Shortened doublet reads standing (fits niṣṭhā rest); shining kept on cakāstu to avoid doubling the same verb.

pdva-p02-v09.speaker: Poet (three-state survey)
pdva-p02-v09.question: What of dream and waking?
premises: In dream the unreal itself is road; in deep sleep manifestation; beyond that, conditionless consciousness-sky — what grasp.
In waking, earth-firm heap even for a moment — then by knowing, past that, this apart: what refutation.
pdva-p02-v09.inference: Three-state survey ending in unrefutability: dream-road, sleep-show, waking-heap — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
uncertainties: Print variants v9 (saraṇa/sauṣupta vs maraṇa/sauṣumna) recorded; edition followed.

pdva-p02-v10.speaker: Poet (identity)
pdva-p02-v10.question: Who shines?
premises: Whatever lights in me, in highest sky room-found — shine in me in eternal glory undistinguished.
I am He: unfeigned, eternal, unbroken-measured, infinite, true, free — foe-pair darkness dispelled.
pdva-p02-v10.inference: All lights mine, shining in me without division: so'ham as infinite true free dispeller of the foe-pair's darkness.

pdva-p02-v11.speaker: Poet (permission)
pdva-p02-v11.question: What may play?
premises: Let time reckon, creator create, love churn under command.
Play-pomp sky-abiding as it were, self-drawn lines, body-abiding; in delusion's evil — what unseen.
pdva-p02-v11.inference: Cosmic permission: time, creation, desire all let be; the play abides in body; nothing unseen even in delusion's evil.

pdva-p02-v12.speaker: Poet (devourer)
pdva-p02-v12.question: Whom to devour?
premises: Who here sir whom I devour; whom suddenly slay.
Whom — supreme-waking-abode-devouring-frenzied — I drink.
pdva-p02-v12.inference: Triple devouring of otherness: devour, slay, drink — incorporation of all as supreme-waking-abode.
uncertainties: Print variant ko'tra bhor ahaṃ (I devour/slay/drink) vs edition ko'tra bhor yaṃ (whom); edition kept, variant noted.

pdva-p02-v13.speaker: Ramyadeva (seal)
pdva-p02-v13.question: How does it close?
premises: Becoming-born fear shattered, jackals scared; on wisdom's yoke, even of wise, for once what awakening.
From beyond-contentment upsurge in dense-forest wandering, Hari Rāmyadeva made non-difference-elephant trumpet.
pdva-p02-v13.inference: Seal by another's hand: Ramyadeva's verse — fear routed, awakening once, non-difference trumpeted.

pdva-p01-v01.plain_english: Enjoy peace, always. With few words, stop the chatter-course. By the way of its stopping ask: what is this, how, who am I — and do not doubt. Whatever shines in unbroken sequence, making being and nonbeing shine apart — that is void, Śiva's abode, the highest real thing, brahman. Then what grasping is here?
pdva-p01-v01.sanskrit_cite: śāntiṃ sambhaja nityam alpavacanair jalpakramaṃ saṃhara | tatsaṃhāragamena kiṃ katham idaṃ ko 'sīti mā cīkḷpaḥ | bhāvābhāvavibhāgabhāsakatayā yad bhāty abhagnakramaṃ | tac chūnyaṃ śivadhāma vastu paramaṃ brahmātha ko 'tra grahaḥ

pdva-p01-v02.plain_english: If you reach reality only after first rejecting non-reality, that itself is non-reality. But if non-reality is then reality itself — that is not reality, and not like that.
pdva-p01-v02.sanskrit_cite: yady atattvaparihārapūrvakaṃ tattvam eṣi tad atattvam eva hi | yady atattvam atha tattvam eva vātattvam eva na tu tattvam īdṛśam

pdva-p01-v03.plain_english: Nothing that shines stands apart from shining. If you say even difference shines — in shining, it does not shine. So give up the grasping at its breaking-ways. In dream, having become dream itself — mere play, no maker of fear: sword-blows, plunges into water, fire-eating, thunder-claps and the rest.
pdva-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: yad yad bhāti na bhānataḥ pṛthag idaṃ bhedo 'pi bhātīti ced | bhāne so 'pi na bhāti kiṃ jahi tatas tadbhaṅgibhaṅgagraham | svapne svapnatayā prathāṃ gatavati krīḍaiva no bhītikṛc | chastrāghātajalāvapātahutabhuṅnirghātabandhādikam

pdva-p01-v04.plain_english: First resolve upon knowledge, action, and measuring. Whatever you declare, sir — what sets it apart from the inert? Though quivering, even the inert — is it not the abode of nondual awareness, beginningless, eternal, ungraspable, true-formed?
pdva-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: jñānakriyākalanapūrvakam adhyavasyed | yad yad bhavān kathaya ko 'sya jaḍād viśeṣaḥ | sphūrjañ jaḍo 'pi na kim advayabodhadhāma | nissīmanityaniravagrahasatyarūpam

pdva-p01-v05.plain_english: You who illumine beings — if you are smeared by them, what is that to you? If it shines — hail! — your greatness stands unbroken even there. If not, it is not. Even so, in both cases — unrestrained, unfettered, with delusion unbroken, ever content in greatness — sir, you are ever awake.
pdva-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: bhāvānām avabhāsako 'si yadi tair mālinyam ātanyate | kiṃ te tad yadi bhāti hanta bhavatas tatrāpy akhaṇḍaṃ mahaḥ | no cen nāsti tad evam apy ubhayathā nirvyājaniryantraṇātruṭyadvibhramanityatṛptamahimā nityaprabuddho 'si bhoḥ

pdva-p01-v06.plain_english: Send your sight outward, beyond the path of the target. Lest mimicking Bhairava be mere fraud. For the sky of nondual waking there is no outside; no inside for the abode of spaceless unfolding.
pdva-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭiṃ bahiḥ prahiṇu lakṣyapathātiriktaṃ | syād bhairavānukaraṇaṃ vata vañcaneyam | nirdvandvabodhagaganasya na bāhyam asti | nābhyantaraṃ niravakāśavikāsadhāmnaḥ

pdva-p01-v07.plain_english: When the agitation of desire's spread rises — whatever flashes, watch just that. In beginning, middle, and ends, if there — you shine, you shine; all dissolves into you.
pdva-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: vāsanāprasaravibhramodaye | yad yad ullasati tad tad īkṣyatām | ādimadhyanidhaneṣu tatra ced | bhāsi bhāsi tava līyate 'khilam

pdva-p02-v08.plain_english: Delusion — dense with suffering, conjecture, and piled-up reasoning, with chains of error teeming one after another from rising causes, like a mirage-city. If it does not shine in the sky of consciousness, the ground of the refuge of dual and nondual thought — where else could the highest rest stand, even for the many-selfed?
pdva-p02-v08.sanskrit_cite: moho duḥkhavitarkatarkaṇaghano hetuprathānantaraprodyadvibhramaśṛṅkhalātibahulo gandharvapūḥsannibhaḥ | dvaitādvaitavikalpanāśrayapade cidvyomni nābhāti cet | kutrānyatra cakāstu kāstu paramā niṣṭhāpy anekātmanām

pdva-p02-v09.plain_english: In dream, after all, the unreal itself is the road, and there is display in deep sleep's abode. But beyond that, in the conditionless sky of consciousness — what grasp does he have? In waking, if the heap of things stood firm as earth even for a moment somewhere — then through knowledge, past that, this as apart: what refutation even there?
pdva-p02-v09.sanskrit_cite: svapne tāvad asatyam eva saraṇaṃ sausuptadhāmni prathā | naivāsyāsti taduttare nirupadhau cidvyomni ko 'sya grahaḥ | jāgraty eva dharāvad arthanicayaḥ syāc cet kṣaṇe kutracij | jñānenātha tadatyaye pṛthag idaṃ tatrāpi kā khaṇḍanā

pdva-p02-v10.plain_english: Whatever lights there are — abiding in me, having found room in the highest sky — they shine in me, in eternal glory, undistinguished. I am He — unfeigned, eternal, of unbroken measure, infinite, true, free — dispelling the darkness of the foe-pair, nondual and not, beginningless waking light.
pdva-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: ye ye ke 'pi prakāśā mayi sati paramavyomni labdhāvakāśāḥ | kāśā hy eteṣu nitye mahimani mayi te nirvibhāgaṃ vibhānti | so 'haṃ nirvyājanityapratihatakalanānantasatyasvatantradhvastadvaitādvayāridvayamayatimirāpārabodhaprakāśaḥ

pdva-p02-v11.plain_english: Let time, reckoning the measures, reckon on. Let the creator eagerly create. Brought under another's sway by command, let love churn. Play-pomp, sky-abiding as it were, in the sequence of self-drawn lines — let it rest on body and the rest. In the evil of distorted great delusion — what do I not see?
pdva-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: kālaḥ saṅkalayan kalāḥ kalayatu sraṣṭā sṛjatv ādarād | ājñāyāḥ paratantratām upagato mathnātu vā manmathaḥ | krīḍāḍambara ambarāśrayam iva svollekharekhākramaṃ | dehādyāśrayam astu vaikṛtamahāmohe na paśyāmi kim

pdva-p02-v12.plain_english: Who is here, sir? Whom shall I devour? Who is here, sir? Whom shall I suddenly slay? Who is here, sir? Whom — frenzied-bodied in devouring the supreme waking-abode — shall I drink?
pdva-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ kavalīkaromi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ sahasā nihanmi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ parabodhadhāmasañcarvaṇonmattatanuḥ pivāmi

pdva-p02-v13.plain_english: The shattering of becoming-born fear, the scaring of the affliction-jackals. Even the wise on wisdom's yoke — for once, what an awakening! From the upsurge of beyond-contentment in wandering the dense forest, Hari Rāmyadeva made the non-difference-elephant trumpet.
pdva-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavotthabhayabhaṅgadaṅ gadaśṛgālavidrāvaṇaṃ | prabodhadhuri dhīmatām api sakṛd yad uddīpanam | sudhāma gahanāṭavīviharaṇātitṛptyudgamād | abhedakaribṛṃhitaṃ vyadhita ramyadevo hariḥ

essence: Peace enjoyed, chatter stopped with few words; self-asked what-how-who without doubt — void as Śiva's abode, highest real, brahman.
Reality reached only by first rejecting non-reality is that non-reality; non-reality claimed as reality is neither.
Whatever shines is not apart from shining; difference does not add a second shining — grasping its breaking-ways abandoned; dream mere play.
Knowledge, action, measuring first resolved: whatever declared, what sets it apart from the quivering inert — is it not the nondual-awareness-abode.
The illuminator smeared or not stays unbroken in greatness — ever-awake either way.
Sight sent past the target: no outside for nondual waking, no inside for spaceless unfolding; mimicry mere fraud.
Desire rising watched flash by flash: shining, shining, all dissolving into you.

rasa.justification: Refutation after refutation leaves the ground clear and quiet; the vigor is in the asking (what-how-who, what distinguishes, what if smeared), never in assertion. Stillness argued for, not assumed.

sections.SUMMARY: Peace enjoyed, chatter stopped with few words; self-asked what-how-who without doubt — void as Śiva's abode, highest real, brahman. Reality reached only by first rejecting non-reality is that non-reality; non-reality claimed as reality is neither. Whatever shines is not apart from shining; difference does not add a second shining — grasping its breaking-ways abandoned; dream mere play. Knowledge, action, measuring first resolved: whatever declared, what sets it apart from the quivering inert — is it not the nondual-awareness-abode. The illuminator smeared or not stays unbroken in greatness — ever-awake either way. Sight sent past the target: no outside for nondual waking, no inside for spaceless unfolding; mimicry mere fraud. Desire rising watched flash by flash: shining, shining, all dissolving into you.
sections.FUNCTION: Clears the ground by refutation, then gives the two practices: gaze past all targets, watching of every flash.
sections.KEY TERMS: jalpakrama (chatter-course as what stops); tattvam/atattvam (reality/non-reality as conditional pair); bhāna (shining as non-difference); jaḍa (inert as quivering); avabhāsaka (illuminator); lakṣyapathātirikta (past-target); īkṣyatām (watched).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Maṅgala and refutations passed; gaze and desire practices begin.
sections.BOUNDARY: No result stated yet; the practices are doors, not attainments.
sections.EXPLANATION: The opening enjoins the conditions of inquiry — peace, brevity, cessation — and aims them at the void that is Śiva's abode. Then the dialectic: mediated attainment collapses into its means, so reality-by-rejection is non-reality; appearance splits nothing from shining, so difference adds no second light and its breaking-ways go ungrasped, dreams included as mere play. If even the inert quivers, no line separates it from the beginningless ungraspable abode. The knower smeared or clean stays whole. Sight is sent where no target stands — outside and inside both refused — and whatever rises in desire is watched until, shining, it dissolves into the watcher.
sections.RELATED: Sferra Hamburg e-text (same recension, verification); Abhinavastotravali print variants documented in lore and argmaps; Ramyadeva close (v13 another hand).

sections.FUNCTION: From cosmology to identity to permission to devouring, ending in another's close.
sections.KEY TERMS: cidvyomni (consciousness-sky as the only seat); so'ham (I-He as found fact); krīḍāḍambara (play-pomp as permission); kavalīkaromi (I-devour as incorporation); abhedakaribṛṃhita (non-difference-elephant-trumpet as close-image); cakāstu/kāstu (may-shine/may-stand — fork adjudicated).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: The refutations done; delusion placed, states surveyed, identity declared, play permitted, otherness eaten, close set by Ramyadeva.
sections.BOUNDARY: The print variant (I devour vs whom) stays recorded, not adopted; the close stays Ramyadeva's, not Abhinavagupta's.
sections.EXPLANATION: Delusion gets its full weight — suffering-dense, error-chained, mirage-vast — then loses its last seat: unshown in consciousness-sky, it grounds nothing, not even for the many. Dream, sleep, waking each yield the same verdict: gone beyond by knowing, never refuted from inside. Then the turn: every light already in me, shining without division — He-I, infinite and free. Permission follows: time, makers, lovers all let be, the play at home in the body, nothing hidden even in delusion's evil. Then incorporation itself: devour, slay, drink — otherness eaten three times over. The close belongs to another voice: fear routed, jackals scattered, one awakening on wisdom's yoke, non-difference trumpeted.

lines: Nothing shining stands apart from shine; though difference be said to shine,
in shining it shines not — leave grasping its breakings; dream turned dream, mere play, no frightener: sword, plunge, fire, thunder, rest.
pdva-p01-v03.sanskrit_cite: yad yad bhāti na bhānataḥ pṛthag idaṃ bhedo 'pi bhātīti ced | bhāne so 'pi na bhāti kiṃ jahi tatas tadbhaṅgibhaṅgagraham | svapne svapnatayā prathāṃ gatavati krīḍaiva no bhītikṛc | chastrāghātajalāvapātahutabhuṅnirghātabandhādikam

lines: First resolve on knowing, action, measure — whatever you proclaim, sir,
what parts it from the quivering inert? Is it not the beginningless, eternal, ungraspable, true-formed nondual-awareness home?
pdva-p01-v04.sanskrit_cite: jñānakriyākalanapūrvakam adhyavasyed | yad yad bhavān kathaya ko 'sya jaḍād viśeṣaḥ | sphūrjañ jaḍo 'pi na kim advayabodhadhāma | nissīmanityaniravagrahasatyarūpam

lines: Being-illuminer — stained by them, what is that to you? Shine or not, greatness holds unbroken;
both ways unrestrained, unfettered, delusion unbroken, ever content, sir ever awake.
pdva-p01-v05.sanskrit_cite: bhāvānām avabhāsako 'si yadi tair mālinyam ātanyate | kiṃ te tad yadi bhāti hanta bhavatas tatrāpy akhaṇḍaṃ mahaḥ | no cen nāsti tad evam apy ubhayathā nirvyājaniryantraṇātruṭyadvibhramanityatṛptamahimā nityaprabuddho 'si bhoḥ

lines: Send sight out past the target-path — Bhairava-mimicry would be fraud;
for nondual waking sky there is no without, no within for the spaceless-unfolding home.
pdva-p01-v06.sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭiṃ bahiḥ prahiṇu lakṣyapathātiriktaṃ | syād bhairavānukaraṇaṃ vata vañcaneyam | nirdvandvabodhagaganasya na bāhyam asti | nābhyantaraṃ niravakāśavikāsadhāmnaḥ

lines: When the stir of desire's spread rises — whatever flashes, watch that;
in first, in middle, in ends, if there — shine, shine; all melts into you.
pdva-p01-v07.sanskrit_cite: vāsanāprasaravibhramodaye | yad yad ullasati tad tad īkṣyatām | ādimadhyanidhaneṣu tatra ced | bhāsi bhāsi tava līyate 'khilam

lines: Delusion — suffering-thick, surmise-piled reasoning, error-chains swarming from ever-rising causes, mirage-town-like —
unshining in consciousness-sky, ground of dual-nor-nondual thought-rest: where else could the highest stand stay, even for the many-selfed?
pdva-p02-v08.sanskrit_cite: moho duḥkhavitarkatarkaṇaghano hetuprathānantaraprodyadvibhramaśṛṅkhalātibahulo gandharvapūḥsannibhaḥ | dvaitādvaitavikalpanāśrayapade cidvyomni nābhāti cet | kutrānyatra cakāstu kāstu paramā niṣṭhāpy anekātmanām

lines: Dream's road is the unreal after all; display in deep-sleep's house —
past that, in conditionless consciousness-sky, what grasp is his? If waking's heap stood earth-firm even a moment somewhere, then by knowing past that, this apart — what refutation even there?
pdva-p02-v09.sanskrit_cite: svapne tāvad asatyam eva saraṇaṃ sausuptadhāmni prathā | naivāsyāsti taduttare nirupadhau cidvyomni ko 'sya grahaḥ | jāgraty eva dharāvad arthanicayaḥ syāc cet kṣaṇe kutracij | jñānenātha tadatyaye pṛthag idaṃ tatrāpi kā khaṇḍanā

lines: Whatever lights abide in me, in highest heaven room-found, shine in me eternal-famed, unparted — I am He:
unfeigned, eternal, unbroken-ruled, boundless, true, free, dispelling the foe-pair's dark, nondual-not, beginningless waking-light.
pdva-p02-v10.sanskrit_cite: ye ye ke 'pi prakāśā mayi sati paramavyomni labdhāvakāśāḥ | kāśā hy eteṣu nitye mahimani mayi te nirvibhāgaṃ vibhānti | so 'haṃ nirvyājanityapratihatakalanānantasatyasvatantradhvastadvaitādvayāridvayamayatimirāpārabodhaprakāśaḥ

lines: Reckon, time, the measures; creator, eagerly create; churn, love, command-swayed —
play-pomp sky-homed as it were, in self-drawn line-trains, rest on body-and-all: in perverse great folly's stain, what see I not?
pdva-p02-v11.sanskrit_cite: kālaḥ saṅkalayan kalāḥ kalayatu sraṣṭā sṛjatv ādarād | ājñāyāḥ paratantratām upagato mathnātu vā manmathaḥ | krīḍāḍambara ambarāśrayam iva svollekharekhākramaṃ | dehādyāśrayam astu vaikṛtamahāmohe na paśyāmi kim

lines: Who here, sir, shall I swallow; who here, sir, suddenly slay;
who here, sir — frenzied-formed in supreme-waking-home-devouring — shall I drink?
pdva-p02-v12.sanskrit_cite: kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ kavalīkaromi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ sahasā nihanmi | kaḥ ko 'tra bhor yaṃ parabodhadhāmasañcarvaṇonmattatanuḥ pivāmi

lines: Becoming-born fear shattered, jackal-pack scared; on wisdom's yoke even the wise —
for once, what waking! From beyond-contentment's rise in deep-forest roaming, Rāmyadeva Hari made the non-difference-elephant trumpet.
pdva-p02-v13.sanskrit_cite: bhavotthabhayabhaṅgadaṅ gadaśṛgālavidrāvaṇaṃ | prabodhadhuri dhīmatām api sakṛd yad uddīpanam | sudhāma gahanāṭavīviharaṇātitṛptyudgamād | abhedakaribṛṃhitaṃ vyadhita ramyadevo hariḥ

lines: Take peace always; few words — the chatter-course stopped:
ask what, how, who by its stopping — and doubt nothing;

lines: If non-rejection first is how you reach the real, that is just unreal —
if the unreal then counts as real, that is not real, nor such.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: frame vow (FIRST-VERSE voice: plain, declarative, end-weighted questions; sets house voice — owner verdict required). Sanskrit: śāntiṃ sambhaja...mā cīkḷpaḥ → L4 keeps enjoin-ask-shine triad in quatrain. Rows: row 3 (shines→grasp). Close: here (grahaḥ as where-grasping lands). Rejected: 'meditation manual' framing — killed: maṅgala kept as vow; softening cīkḷpaḥ — kept doubt nothing (prohibition absolute).

reads_against.argmap: What is enjoined first? → The maṅgala injunction: peace, brevity, cessation as the gate; self-questioning without doubt.
c1_essence: Peace enjoyed, chatter stopped with few words; self-asked what-how-who without doubt — void as Śiva's abode, highest real, brahman.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: collapse-conditional (if-then that eats itself). Rows: row 2 (unreal→not-real). Close: such (īdṛśam as the dismissive closer). Rejected: 'means justify ends' moral — killed: kept conditional (the logic IS the verse); 'that is false' — kept not-real-nor-such (double denial kept).

reads_against.argmap: What follows from the condition? → Conditional refutation: mediated attainment collapses into its means; identity-claims about tattva fail both ways.
c1_essence: Reality reached only by first rejecting non-reality is that non-reality; non-reality claimed as reality is neither.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: non-difference stated (shining refuses second). Rows: row 2 (shines-not→leave). Close: rest (ādikam as and-the-rest: the list closes flat). Rejected: 'nonduality' label — killed: kept shining-talk (the verse never names advaya); taming the terror-list — kept sword-plunge-fire-thunder whole.

reads_against.argmap: What shines? → Non-difference of appearance and awareness: difference is not a second shining; grasping modes of breaking is abandoned.
c1_essence: Whatever shines is not apart from shining; difference does not add a second shining — grasping its breaking-ways abandoned; dream mere play.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: inert-quivers (the question that dignifies matter). Rows: row 3 (quivering→home?). Close: home (dhāma as landing: the question lands IN the abode). Rejected: 'consciousness' for awareness — kept awareness (bodha precise); 'who is conscious' — kept what-parts (the verse asks distinction, not subject).

reads_against.argmap: What distinguishes from the inert? → The inert quivers too: if it moves, what excludes it from the advaya-awareness-abode — beginningless, eternal, ungraspable, true-formed?
c1_essence: Knowledge, action, measuring first resolved: whatever declared, what sets it apart from the quivering inert — is it not the nondual-awareness-abode.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: unsmearable (either way awake). Rows: row 3 (unbroken→awake). Close: awake (nityaprabuddha as the standing epithet). Rejected: 'pure' for stainless — no stain-word here; kept smeared (the verse's own verb); 'whether' flattening — kept shine-or-not (the either-or IS the structure).

reads_against.argmap: What if the illuminator is smeared? → Smearing cannot touch the illuminator: shining or not, greatness stays unbroken; both alternatives dissolve into ever-awake being.
c1_essence: The illuminator smeared or not stays unbroken in greatness — ever-awake either way.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: past-target (gaze with nowhere to go). Rows: row 3 (fraud→home). Close: home (dhāmnaḥ as landing: the spaceless home). Rejected: 'transcendence' — killed: past-target kept (spatial, not lofty); 'worship' for mimicry — kept fraud (vañcana as the verse's verdict).

reads_against.argmap: Where should sight go? → Gaze sent past every target: inner and outer denied alike; imitating the state without being it is fraud.
c1_essence: Sight sent past the target: no outside for nondual waking, no inside for spaceless unfolding; mimicry mere fraud.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: watch-the-flash (desire as instruction). Rows: row 2 (flashes→dissolves). Close: you (tava as landing: dissolves INTO YOU). Rejected: 'observe the mind' — killed: watch-that kept (directed, not general); 'liberation' — kept dissolves (laya as event).

reads_against.argmap: What is watched? → Desire-practice: attend the flash itself at every phase; the watcher shining, all melts into you.
c1_essence: Desire rising watched flash by flash: shining, shining, all dissolving into you.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: delusion-unseated (cosmology with no address). Rows: row 3 (unshining→where). Close: many-selfed (anekātman as landing: even the many). Rejected: 'ignorance' for delusion — kept delusion (moha active, not privative); answering where — kept the question (no seat given).

reads_against.argmap: Where does delusion rest? → Delusion has no other seat: failing to appear in consciousness-sky, no highest rest stands anywhere — even for the many-selfed.
c1_essence: Delusion dense with suffering and error-chains, mirage-city-like: if it does not shine in consciousness-sky, no highest rest anywhere.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: unrefuted (three states, no refutation). Rows: row 3 (apart→refutation?). Close: there (tatrāpi as landing: even there). Rejected: 'dream is unreal, so ignore it' — killed: road kept (saraṇa as way-through, not dismissal); 'therefore Vedānta' — kept the question (no school named).

reads_against.argmap: What of dream and waking? → Three-state survey ending in unrefutability: dream-road, sleep-show, waking-heap — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
c1_essence: Dream's road unreal, deep sleep display, waking heap earth-firm — each passed beyond by knowing, none refuted from inside.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta settling (wonder worked through to rest)

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: so'ham (all lights mine). Rows: row 3 (undivided→He). Close: light (prabodhaprakāśaḥ as landing: beginningless waking light). Rejected: splitting the giant compound — kept whole-chain (one breath, the verse's own weight); 'I am That' — kept I-am-He (so'ham personal, not tat).

reads_against.argmap: Who shines? → All lights mine, shining in me without division: so'ham as infinite true free dispeller of the foe-pair's darkness.
c1_essence: All lights in me, room-found in highest sky, shining undistinguished: I am He, infinite, true, free.
